name: Sm2D (2D Volume Texture Experiment)
definition: A 2-dimensional test application implemented as a 2D ray tracer to investigate the applicability of a texture-based approach for smoke volumes. Tetrahedra are represented by triangles, and the viewport simplifies to a 1-dimensional function.
summary: Sm2D is a 2D ray tracer that simplifies volume rendering to a 1D viewport function, serving as a diagnostic tool to demonstrate the precision limits and rotational artifacts of texture-based approximations.
